title: MaleTheme Solo #018 · 남 머슬 모델·피치 듀이·소방관 테마·무늬
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Kenyan man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, deep ebony skin with a soft glow, a warm natural smile, natural soft black hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a copper round bell, a lead cube-shaped block, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten mixed-metal anklets. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red-and-yellow firefighter helmet with a clear visor pushed up, yellow reflective-striped suspenders running over his bare shoulders and chest, and a minimal glossy red leopard-print T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a yellow reflective stripe, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
